_note: Level Set 2026-10-14 (walk #66, Family Members): NEW riddle frames for the relation-riddles face (new pages only; the published bank is untouched). Two families, written in each locale's published riddle pattern: the parent of an aunt / uncle (answer = a grandparent word; key 'MZ.M' = the mother of MZ = MM, see _paths) and the child of an aunt / uncle (answer = a cousin word; key = the kin path MZD …). Answers are re-derived from the kin map, never stored here. _bloodSide: the locales (and keys) whose aunt / uncle word names the blood side (fi eno / setä also cover an uncle by marriage in everyday use — review 2026-10-14 — so fi keeps only the cousin riddles) — only there is "the aunt's mother" always the grandmother (an English aunt may be an aunt by marriage).
